-- What a client importing `Proof.go_etcd_io.raft.v3.PbContent` sees of it (generated by etc/gen-interface.py; do not edit).
-- Every declaration also takes the ambient section variables (left out below): the Go semantics
-- (`ext`, `ffi`, `go_gctx`, `sem`, the package's `Assumptions`), `GF`, `hG`, `StorageModel GF`, `AllG GF`.

def csSize (c : CSC) : Nat :=
  repW64Size c.voters + repW64Size c.learners + repW64Size c.votersOutgoing + repW64Size c.learnersNext +
      optBoolSize c.autoLeave +
    c.uf.length

def metaLevels : Option SnapMetaC → List (FieldSchema × List w8) :=
  match x✝ with
  | none => []
  | some m => (metaSchema, m.uf) :: csLevels m.confState

theorem metaRoC_persistent (p : Loc) (m : SnapMetaC) : Persistent (metaRoC p m)

def metaOptC (p : Loc) : Option SnapMetaC → IProp GF :=
  match x✝ with
  | none => iprop(⌜p = null⌝)
  | some m => metaRoC p m

def bytesC (ds : GoSlice) : Option (List w8) → IProp GF :=
  match x✝ with
  | none => iprop(⌜ds = slice.nil⌝)
  | some bs => iprop(⌜ds ≠ slice.nil⌝ ∗ ownSlice ds bs DFrac.discard)

theorem entsRO_entsRoC (els : List Loc) (es : List EntryM) : ([∗list] p;e ∈ els;es, entRO p e) ⊢ ∃
    ecs, ([∗list] p;c ∈ els;ecs, entRoC p c) ∗ ⌜List.map EntryC.model ecs = es⌝

def csRoC (p : Loc) (c : CSC) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ sv sl so sn pa,
      ⌜p ≠ null⌝ ∗
        typedPointsto (structFieldRef raftpb.ConfState go!"Voters" p) sv DFrac.discard ∗
          ownSlice sv c.voters DFrac.discard ∗
            typedPointsto (structFieldRef raftpb.ConfState go!"Learners" p) sl
                DFrac.discard ∗
              ownSlice sl c.learners DFrac.discard ∗
                typedPointsto
                    (structFieldRef raftpb.ConfState
                      go!"VotersOutgoing" p)
                    so DFrac.discard ∗
                  ownSlice so c.votersOutgoing DFrac.discard ∗
                    typedPointsto
                        (structFieldRef raftpb.ConfState
                          go!"LearnersNext" p)
                        sn DFrac.discard ∗
                      ownSlice sn c.learnersNext DFrac.discard ∗
                        typedPointsto
                            (structFieldRef raftpb.ConfState go!"AutoLeave"
                              p)
                            pa DFrac.discard ∗
                          optCell pa c.autoLeave ∗ pbMsg raftpb.ConfState p c.uf)

def EntryC.model (c : EntryC) : EntryM :=
  { Term' := c.term.getD (zero_val w64), Index' := c.index.getD (zero_val w64),
    Type' := c.type.getD (zero_val raftpb.EntryType), Data' := c.data.getD [] }

theorem MsgC.brecOn.eq.{u} {motive_1 : MsgC → Sort u} {motive_2 : List (Loc × MsgC) → Sort u}
    {motive_3 : Loc × MsgC → Sort u} (t : MsgC) (F_1 : (t : MsgC) → t.below → motive_1 t) (F_2 : (t
    : List (Loc × MsgC)) → MsgC.below_1 t → motive_2 t) (F_3 : (t : Loc × MsgC) → MsgC.below_2 t →
    motive_3 t) : t.brecOn F_1 F_2 F_3 = F_1 t (MsgC.brecOn.go t F_1 F_2 F_3).2

def metaSize (m : SnapMetaC) : Nat :=
  (match m.confState with
        | none => 0
        | some c => lenSize (csSize c)) +
        optW64Size m.index +
      optW64Size m.term +
    m.uf.length

theorem respsRoC_persistent (rs : List (Loc × MsgC)) : Persistent (respsRoC rs)

def csZero : ConfStateM :=
  { Voters' := [], Learners' := [], VotersOutgoing' := [], LearnersNext' := [], AutoLeave' := false }

def csOptC (p : Loc) : Option CSC → IProp GF :=
  match x✝ with
  | none => iprop(⌜p = null⌝)
  | some c => csRoC p c

def csLevels : Option CSC → List (FieldSchema × List w8) :=
  match x✝ with
  | none => []
  | some c => [(csSchema, c.uf)]

theorem entRoC_entRO (l : Loc) (c : EntryC) : entRoC l c ⊢ entRO l c.model

theorem pbMsg_uf_entry (l : Loc) (uf : List w8) : pbMsg raftpb.Entry l uf ⊢ ⌜ufWire entrySchema uf⌝

theorem msgRoC_persistent (l : Loc) (c : MsgC) : Persistent (msgRoC l c)

theorem ownSlice_bytesC (ds : GoSlice) (xs : List w8) : ownSlice ds xs DFrac.discard ⊢ ∃ o, bytesC
    ds o ∗ ⌜o.getD [] = xs⌝

theorem optCell_cellRO {V : Type} [ZeroVal V] [TypedPointsto V] (p : Loc) (o : Option V) : optCell p
    o ⊢ cellRO p (o.getD (zero_val V))

theorem respsRoC_uf (rs : List (Loc × MsgC)) : respsRoC rs ⊢ ⌜∀ (q : FieldSchema × List w8), q ∈
    respsLevels rs → ufWire q.fst q.snd⌝

def CSC.model (c : CSC) : ConfStateM :=
  { Voters' := c.voters, Learners' := c.learners, VotersOutgoing' := c.votersOutgoing, LearnersNext' := c.learnersNext,
    AutoLeave' := c.autoLeave.getD (zero_val Bool) }

structure SnapC : Type where
  data : Option (List w8)
  metadata : Option SnapMetaC
  uf : List w8

def repW64Size (xs : List w64) : Nat :=
  (List.map (fun v => 1 + varintSize (uint.Z v).toNat) xs).sum

theorem snapRoC_persistent (p : Loc) (s : SnapC) : Persistent (snapRoC p s)

def snapLevels : Option SnapC → List (FieldSchema × List w8) :=
  match x✝ with
  | none => []
  | some s => (snapSchema, s.uf) :: metaLevels s.metadata

def MsgC.csUfNil (c : MsgC) : Prop :=
  ∀ (s : SnapC), s ∈ c.f.snapshot → ∀ (m : SnapMetaC), m ∈ s.metadata → ∀ (cs : CSC), cs ∈ m.confState → cs.uf = []

def respsLevels : List (Loc × MsgC) → List (FieldSchema × List w8) :=
  MsgC.brecOn_1 x✝ MsgC.levels._f respsLevels._f fun t f => PUnit.unit

theorem msgRoC_uf (l : Loc) (c : MsgC) : msgRoC l c ⊢ ⌜∀ (q : FieldSchema × List w8), q ∈ c.levels →
    ufWire q.fst q.snd⌝

theorem csOptC_persistent (p : Loc) (o : Option CSC) : Persistent (csOptC p o)

theorem pbMsg_uf_cs (p : Loc) (uf : List w8) : pbMsg raftpb.ConfState p uf ⊢ ⌜ufWire csSchema uf⌝

def respsSize : List (Loc × MsgC) → Nat :=
  MsgC.brecOn_1 x✝ msgSize._f respsSize._f fun t f => PUnit.unit

def MsgC.f : MsgC → MsgFC :=
  match x✝ with
  | MsgC.mk f resps => f

theorem respsRoC.eq_def (x✝ : List (Loc × MsgC)) : respsRoC x✝ = match x✝ with | [] => iprop(emp) |
    (p, c) :: rs => iprop(msgRoC p c ∗ respsRoC rs)

theorem msgRoC_msgOwn (l : Loc) (c : MsgC) (h : c.csUfNil) : msgRoC l c ⊢ msgOwn l DFrac.discard
    c.model

theorem cellRO_optCell {V : Type} [ZeroVal V] [TypedPointsto V] (p : Loc) (v : V) : cellRO p v ⊢ ∃
    o, optCell p o ∗ ⌜o.getD (zero_val V) = v⌝

theorem bytesC_ro (ds : GoSlice) (o : Option (List w8)) : bytesC ds o ⊢ ownSlice ds (o.getD [])
    DFrac.discard

theorem metaRoC_smPts (p : Loc) (m : SnapMetaC) (h : ∀ (cs : CSC), cs ∈ m.confState → cs.uf = []) :
    metaRoC p m ⊢ smPts p DFrac.discard m.model

def MsgFC.levels (f : MsgFC) : List (FieldSchema × List w8) :=
  (msgSchema, f.uf) :: List.map (fun e => (entrySchema, e.uf)) f.entries ++ snapLevels f.snapshot

theorem csOptC_csOptA (p : Loc) (o : Option CSC) (h : ∀ (cs : CSC), cs ∈ o → cs.uf = []) : csOptC p
    o ⊢ csOptA p DFrac.discard ((Option.map CSC.model o).getD csZero)

theorem bytesC_persistent (ds : GoSlice) (o : Option (List w8)) : Persistent (bytesC ds o)

theorem optCell_persistent {V : Type} [ZeroVal V] [TypedPointsto V] (p : Loc) (o : Option V) :
    Persistent (optCell p o)

def snapOptC (p : Loc) : Option SnapC → IProp GF :=
  match x✝ with
  | none => iprop(⌜p = null⌝)
  | some s => snapRoC p s

def msgSize : MsgC → Nat :=
  x✝.brecOn msgSize._f respsSize._f fun t f => PUnit.unit

theorem respsLevels.eq_def (x✝ : List (Loc × MsgC)) : respsLevels x✝ = match x✝ with | [] => [] |
    (fst, c) :: rs => c.levels ++ respsLevels rs

theorem snapOptC_persistent (p : Loc) (o : Option SnapC) : Persistent (snapOptC p o)

def MsgC.resps : MsgC → List (Loc × MsgC) :=
  match x✝ with
  | MsgC.mk f rs => rs

def metaRoC (p : Loc) (m : SnapMetaC) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ pc pi pt,
      ⌜p ≠ null⌝ ∗
        typedPointsto
            (structFieldRef raftpb.SnapshotMetadata go!"ConfState" p) pc
            DFrac.discard ∗
          csOptC pc m.confState ∗
            typedPointsto (structFieldRef raftpb.SnapshotMetadata go!"Index" p) pi DFrac.discard ∗
              optCell pi m.index ∗
                typedPointsto (structFieldRef raftpb.SnapshotMetadata go!"Term" p) pt DFrac.discard ∗
                  optCell pt m.term ∗ pbMsg raftpb.SnapshotMetadata p m.uf)

def metaZero : SnapshotMetadataM :=
  { ConfState' := csZero, Index' := W64 0, Term' := W64 0 }

theorem msgFRoC_persistent (l : Loc) (f : MsgFC) (rps : List Loc) : Persistent (msgFRoC l f rps)

def SnapC.model (s : SnapC) : SnapshotM :=
  { Data' := s.data.getD [], Metadata' := (Option.map SnapMetaC.model s.metadata).getD metaZero }

def optW64Size (o : Option w64) : Nat :=
  optVarintSize (Option.map (fun v => (uint.Z v).toNat) o)

def MsgC.brecOn.go.{u} {motive_1 : MsgC → Sort u} {motive_2 : List (Loc × MsgC) → Sort u} {motive_3
    : Loc × MsgC → Sort u} (t : MsgC) (F_1 : (t : MsgC) → t.below → motive_1 t) (F_2 : (t : List
    (Loc × MsgC)) → MsgC.below_1 t → motive_2 t) (F_3 : (t : Loc × MsgC) → MsgC.below_2 t → motive_3
    t) : motive_1 t ×' t.below :=
  MsgC.rec (fun f resps resps_ih => ⟨F_1 (MsgC.mk f resps) resps_ih, resps_ih⟩) ⟨F_2 [] PUnit.unit, PUnit.unit⟩
    (fun head tail head_ih tail_ih => ⟨F_2 (head :: tail) ⟨head_ih, tail_ih⟩, head_ih, tail_ih⟩)
    (fun fst snd snd_ih => ⟨F_3 (fst, snd) snd_ih, snd_ih⟩) t

def snapSize (s : SnapC) : Nat :=
  (optBytesSize s.data +
      match s.metadata with
      | none => 0
      | some m => lenSize (metaSize m)) +
    s.uf.length

theorem snapOptC_uf (p : Loc) (o : Option SnapC) : snapOptC p o ⊢ ⌜∀ (q : FieldSchema × List w8), q
    ∈ snapLevels o → ufWire q.fst q.snd⌝

theorem csRoC_csPts (p : Loc) (c : CSC) (h : c.uf = []) : csRoC p c ⊢ csPts p DFrac.discard c.model
    false

def snapRoC (p : Loc) (s : SnapC) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ ds pm,
      ⌜p ≠ null⌝ ∗
        typedPointsto (structFieldRef raftpb.Snapshot go!"Data" p) ds DFrac.discard ∗
          bytesC ds s.data ∗
            typedPointsto (structFieldRef raftpb.Snapshot go!"Metadata" p) pm
                DFrac.discard ∗
              metaOptC pm s.metadata ∗ pbMsg raftpb.Snapshot p s.uf)

theorem csOptC_uf (p : Loc) (o : Option CSC) : csOptC p o ⊢ ⌜∀ (q : FieldSchema × List w8), q ∈
    csLevels o → ufWire q.fst q.snd⌝

theorem MsgC.brecOn_1.eq.{u} {motive_1 : MsgC → Sort u} {motive_2 : List (Loc × MsgC) → Sort u}
    {motive_3 : Loc × MsgC → Sort u} (t : List (Loc × MsgC)) (F_1 : (t : MsgC) → t.below → motive_1
    t) (F_2 : (t : List (Loc × MsgC)) → MsgC.below_1 t → motive_2 t) (F_3 : (t : Loc × MsgC) →
    MsgC.below_2 t → motive_3 t) : MsgC.brecOn_1 t F_1 F_2 F_3 = F_2 t (MsgC.brecOn_1.go t F_1 F_2
    F_3).2

inductive MsgC : Type
  | MsgC.mk (f : MsgFC) (resps : List (Loc × MsgC)) : MsgC

def entRoC (l : Loc) (c : EntryC) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ pt pi pty ds,
      ⌜l ≠ null⌝ ∗
        typedPointsto (structFieldRef raftpb.Entry go!"Term" l) pt DFrac.discard ∗
          optCell pt c.term ∗
            typedPointsto (structFieldRef raftpb.Entry go!"Index" l) pi DFrac.discard ∗
              optCell pi c.index ∗
                typedPointsto (structFieldRef raftpb.Entry go!"Type" l) pty DFrac.discard ∗
                  optCell pty c.type ∗
                    typedPointsto (structFieldRef raftpb.Entry go!"Data" l) ds DFrac.discard ∗
                      bytesC ds c.data ∗ pbMsg raftpb.Entry l c.uf)

theorem snapOptC_snapOpt (p : Loc) (o : Option SnapC) (h : ∀ (s : SnapC), s ∈ o → ∀ (m : SnapMetaC),
    m ∈ s.metadata → ∀ (cs : CSC), cs ∈ m.confState → cs.uf = []) : snapOptC p o ⊢ snapOpt p
    DFrac.discard (Option.map SnapC.model o)

theorem entsRoC_uf (els : List Loc) (es : List EntryC) : ([∗list] p;e ∈ els;es, entRoC p e) ⊢ ⌜∀ (e
    : EntryC), e ∈ es → ufWire entrySchema e.uf⌝

structure SnapMetaC : Type where
  confState : Option CSC
  index : Option w64
  term : Option w64
  uf : List w8

theorem entRoC_uf (p : Loc) (e : EntryC) : entRoC p e ⊢ ⌜ufWire entrySchema e.uf⌝

def optVarintSize (o : Option Nat) : Nat :=
  match o with
  | none => 0
  | some n => 1 + varintSize n

theorem smOpt_metaOptC (p : Loc) (md : SnapshotMetadataM) : smOpt p DFrac.discard md ⊢ ∃ o, metaOptC
    p o ∗ ⌜(Option.map SnapMetaC.model o).getD metaZero = md ∧ ∀ (m : SnapMetaC), m ∈ o → ∀ (cs :
    CSC), cs ∈ m.confState → cs.uf = []⌝

theorem snapOpt_snapOptC (p : Loc) (o : Option SnapshotM) : snapOpt p DFrac.discard o ⊢ ∃ oc,
    snapOptC p oc ∗ ⌜Option.map SnapC.model oc = o ∧ ∀ (s : SnapC), s ∈ oc → ∀ (m : SnapMetaC), m ∈
    s.metadata → ∀ (cs : CSC), cs ∈ m.confState → cs.uf = []⌝

theorem pbMsg_uf_meta (p : Loc) (uf : List w8) : pbMsg raftpb.SnapshotMetadata p uf ⊢ ⌜ufWire
    metaSchema uf⌝

theorem entRO_entRoC (l : Loc) (e : EntryM) : entRO l e ⊢ ∃ c, entRoC l c ∗ ⌜c.model = e⌝

theorem optCell_cellRO' {V : Type} [ZeroVal V] [TypedPointsto V] (p : Loc) (o : Option V) : optCell
    p o ⊢ cellRO p (o.getD (zero_val V))

theorem msgOwn_msgRoC (l : Loc) (st : MsgSt) (hr : st.resps = []) : msgOwn l DFrac.discard st ⊢ ∃ c,
    msgRoC l c ∗ ⌜c.model = st ∧ c.csUfNil⌝

theorem msgRoC_ents (l : Loc) (c : MsgC) : msgRoC l c ⊢ ∃ es els, typedPointsto (structFieldRef
    raftpb.Message go!"Entries" l) es DFrac.discard ∗ ownSlice es els DFrac.discard ∗ [∗list] p;e ∈
    els;c.f.entries, entRoC p e

def entrySize (c : EntryC) : Nat :=
  (optVarintSize (Option.map (fun t => (uint.Z (W64 (sint.Z t))).toNat) c.type) +
          optVarintSize (Option.map (fun v => (uint.Z v).toNat) c.term) +
        optVarintSize (Option.map (fun v => (uint.Z v).toNat) c.index) +
      match c.data with
      | none => 0
      | some bs => 1 + varintSize bs.length + bs.length) +
    c.uf.length

def MsgC.brecOn_1.go.{u} {motive_1 : MsgC → Sort u} {motive_2 : List (Loc × MsgC) → Sort u}
    {motive_3 : Loc × MsgC → Sort u} (t : List (Loc × MsgC)) (F_1 : (t : MsgC) → t.below → motive_1
    t) (F_2 : (t : List (Loc × MsgC)) → MsgC.below_1 t → motive_2 t) (F_3 : (t : Loc × MsgC) →
    MsgC.below_2 t → motive_3 t) : motive_2 t ×' MsgC.below_1 t :=
  MsgC.rec_1 (fun f resps resps_ih => ⟨F_1 (MsgC.mk f resps) resps_ih, resps_ih⟩) ⟨F_2 [] PUnit.unit, PUnit.unit⟩
    (fun head tail head_ih tail_ih => ⟨F_2 (head :: tail) ⟨head_ih, tail_ih⟩, head_ih, tail_ih⟩)
    (fun fst snd snd_ih => ⟨F_3 (fst, snd) snd_ih, snd_ih⟩) t

theorem entsRoC_entsRO (els : List Loc) (ecs : List EntryC) : ([∗list] p;e ∈ els;ecs, entRoC p e) ⊢
    [∗list] p;e ∈ els;List.map EntryC.model ecs, entRO p e

theorem pbMsg_uf_msg (l : Loc) (uf : List w8) : pbMsg raftpb.Message l uf ⊢ ⌜ufWire msgSchema uf⌝

theorem MsgC.brecOn_2.eq.{u} {motive_1 : MsgC → Sort u} {motive_2 : List (Loc × MsgC) → Sort u}
    {motive_3 : Loc × MsgC → Sort u} (t : Loc × MsgC) (F_1 : (t : MsgC) → t.below → motive_1 t) (F_2
    : (t : List (Loc × MsgC)) → MsgC.below_1 t → motive_2 t) (F_3 : (t : Loc × MsgC) → MsgC.below_2
    t → motive_3 t) : MsgC.brecOn_2 t F_1 F_2 F_3 = F_3 t (MsgC.brecOn_2.go t F_1 F_2 F_3).2

def MsgC.brecOn_2.go.{u} {motive_1 : MsgC → Sort u} {motive_2 : List (Loc × MsgC) → Sort u}
    {motive_3 : Loc × MsgC → Sort u} (t : Loc × MsgC) (F_1 : (t : MsgC) → t.below → motive_1 t) (F_2
    : (t : List (Loc × MsgC)) → MsgC.below_1 t → motive_2 t) (F_3 : (t : Loc × MsgC) → MsgC.below_2
    t → motive_3 t) : motive_3 t ×' MsgC.below_2 t :=
  MsgC.rec_2 (fun f resps resps_ih => ⟨F_1 (MsgC.mk f resps) resps_ih, resps_ih⟩) ⟨F_2 [] PUnit.unit, PUnit.unit⟩
    (fun head tail head_ih tail_ih => ⟨F_2 (head :: tail) ⟨head_ih, tail_ih⟩, head_ih, tail_ih⟩)
    (fun fst snd snd_ih => ⟨F_3 (fst, snd) snd_ih, snd_ih⟩) t

theorem entRoC_persistent (l : Loc) (c : EntryC) : Persistent (entRoC l c)

theorem csOptA_csOptC (p : Loc) (c : ConfStateM) : csOptA p DFrac.discard c ⊢ ∃ o, csOptC p o ∗
    ⌜(Option.map CSC.model o).getD csZero = c ∧ ∀ (cc : CSC), cc ∈ o → cc.uf = []⌝

structure CSC : Type where
  voters : List w64
  learners : List w64
  votersOutgoing : List w64
  learnersNext : List w64
  autoLeave : Option Bool
  uf : List w8

def SnapMetaC.model (m : SnapMetaC) : SnapshotMetadataM :=
  { ConfState' := (Option.map CSC.model m.confState).getD csZero, Index' := m.index.getD (zero_val w64),
    Term' := m.term.getD (zero_val w64) }

theorem pbMsg_uf_snap (p : Loc) (uf : List w8) : pbMsg raftpb.Snapshot p uf ⊢ ⌜ufWire snapSchema uf⌝

theorem csPts_csRoC (p : Loc) (c : ConfStateM) (al : Bool) : csPts p DFrac.discard c al ⊢ ∃ cc,
    csRoC p cc ∗ ⌜cc.model = c ∧ cc.uf = []⌝

def MsgC.levels : MsgC → List (FieldSchema × List w8) :=
  x✝.brecOn MsgC.levels._f respsLevels._f fun t f => PUnit.unit

def msgRoC : Loc → MsgC → IProp GF :=
  x✝.brecOn msgRoC._f respsRoC._f (fun t f => PUnit.unit) x✝¹

def msgFRoC (l : Loc) (f : MsgFC) (rps : List Loc) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ pty pto pfr pte plt pix pco pvo prj prh es els ps cs rs,
      ⌜l ≠ null⌝ ∗
        typedPointsto (structFieldRef raftpb.Message go!"Type" l) pty DFrac.discard ∗
          optCell pty f.type ∗
            typedPointsto (structFieldRef raftpb.Message go!"To" l) pto DFrac.discard ∗
              optCell pto f.to ∗
                typedPointsto (structFieldRef raftpb.Message go!"From" l) pfr DFrac.discard ∗
                  optCell pfr f.frm ∗
                    typedPointsto (structFieldRef raftpb.Message go!"Term" l) pte DFrac.discard ∗
                      optCell pte f.term ∗
                        typedPointsto (structFieldRef raftpb.Message go!"LogTerm" l)
                            plt DFrac.discard ∗
                          optCell plt f.logTerm ∗
                            typedPointsto (structFieldRef raftpb.Message go!"Index" l) pix
                                DFrac.discard ∗
                              optCell pix f.index ∗
                                typedPointsto (structFieldRef raftpb.Message go!"Commit" l)
                                    pco DFrac.discard ∗
                                  optCell pco f.commit ∗
                                    typedPointsto (structFieldRef raftpb.Message go!"Vote" l) pvo
                                        DFrac.discard ∗
                                      optCell pvo f.vote ∗
                                        typedPointsto
                                            (structFieldRef raftpb.Message go!"Reject" l) prj
                                            DFrac.discard ∗
                                          optCell prj f.reject ∗
                                            typedPointsto
                                                (structFieldRef raftpb.Message
                                                  go!"RejectHint" l)
                                                prh DFrac.discard ∗
                                              optCell prh f.rejectHint ∗
                                                typedPointsto
                                                    (structFieldRef raftpb.Message
                                                      go!"Entries" l)
                                                    es DFrac.discard ∗
                                                  ownSlice es els DFrac.discard ∗
                                                    ([∗list] p;e ∈ els;f.entries, entRoC p e) ∗
                                                      typedPointsto
                                                          (structFieldRef raftpb.Message
                                                            go!"Snapshot" l)
                                                          ps DFrac.discard ∗
                                                        snapOptC ps f.snapshot ∗
                                                          typedPointsto
                                                              (structFieldRef raftpb.Message
                                                                go!"Context" l)
                                                              cs DFrac.discard ∗
                                                            bytesC cs f.context ∗
                                                              typedPointsto
                                                                  (structFieldRef raftpb.Message
                                                                    go!"Responses"
                                                                    l)
                                                                  rs DFrac.discard ∗
                                                                ownSlice rs rps DFrac.discard ∗
                                                                  pbMsg raftpb.Message l f.uf)

theorem msgFRoC_uf (l : Loc) (f : MsgFC) (rps : List Loc) : msgFRoC l f rps ⊢ ⌜∀ (q : FieldSchema ×
    List w8), q ∈ f.levels → ufWire q.fst q.snd⌝

theorem metaOptC_persistent (p : Loc) (o : Option SnapMetaC) : Persistent (metaOptC p o)

def MsgFC.size (f : MsgFC) : Nat :=
  (optVarintSize (Option.map (fun t => (uint.Z (W64 (sint.Z t))).toNat) f.type) + optW64Size f.to + optW64Size f.frm +
                        optW64Size f.term +
                      optW64Size f.logTerm +
                    optW64Size f.index +
                  (List.map (fun e => lenSize (entrySize e)) f.entries).sum +
                optW64Size f.commit +
              optW64Size f.vote +
            match f.snapshot with
            | none => 0
            | some s => lenSize (snapSize s)) +
          optBoolSize f.reject +
        optW64Size f.rejectHint +
      optBytesSize f.context +
    f.uf.length

def MsgFC.msgM (f : MsgFC) : MessageM :=
  { Type' := f.type.getD (zero_val raftpb.MessageType), To' := f.to.getD (zero_val w64),
    From' := f.frm.getD (zero_val w64), Term' := f.term.getD (zero_val w64), LogTerm' := f.logTerm.getD (zero_val w64),
    Index' := f.index.getD (zero_val w64), Commit' := f.commit.getD (zero_val w64), Vote' := f.vote.getD (zero_val w64),
    Reject' := f.reject.getD (zero_val Bool), RejectHint' := f.rejectHint.getD (zero_val w64) }

def MsgC.model (c : MsgC) : MsgSt :=
  { msg := c.f.msgM, ents := List.map EntryC.model c.f.entries, snap := Option.map SnapC.model c.f.snapshot,
    ctx := c.f.context.getD [], resps := List.map Prod.fst c.resps }

def lenSize (n : Nat) : Nat :=
  1 + varintSize n + n

structure EntryC : Type where
  term : Option w64
  index : Option w64
  type : Option raftpb.EntryType
  data : Option (List w8)
  uf : List w8

theorem msgRoC.eq_def (x✝ : Loc) (x✝¹ : MsgC) : msgRoC x✝ x✝¹ = match x✝, x✝¹ with | l, MsgC.mk f rs
    => iprop(msgFRoC l f (List.map Prod.fst rs) ∗ respsRoC rs)

theorem csRoC_persistent (p : Loc) (c : CSC) : Persistent (csRoC p c)

def respsRoC : List (Loc × MsgC) → IProp GF :=
  MsgC.brecOn_1 x✝ msgRoC._f respsRoC._f fun t f => PUnit.unit

structure MsgFC : Type where
  type : Option raftpb.MessageType
  to : Option w64
  frm : Option w64
  term : Option w64
  logTerm : Option w64
  index : Option w64
  entries : List EntryC
  commit : Option w64
  vote : Option w64
  snapshot : Option SnapC
  reject : Option Bool
  rejectHint : Option w64
  context : Option (List w8)
  uf : List w8

def optBytesSize : Option (List w8) → Nat :=
  match x✝ with
  | none => 0
  | some bs => lenSize bs.length

theorem metaOptC_uf (p : Loc) (o : Option SnapMetaC) : metaOptC p o ⊢ ⌜∀ (q : FieldSchema × List
    w8), q ∈ metaLevels o → ufWire q.fst q.snd⌝

theorem metaOptC_smOpt (p : Loc) (o : Option SnapMetaC) (h : ∀ (m : SnapMetaC), m ∈ o → ∀ (cs :
    CSC), cs ∈ m.confState → cs.uf = []) : metaOptC p o ⊢ smOpt p DFrac.discard ((Option.map
    SnapMetaC.model o).getD metaZero)

def optBoolSize : Option Bool → Nat :=
  match x✝ with
  | none => 0
  | some val => 2

def optCell {V : Type} [ZeroVal V] [TypedPointsto V] (p : Loc) : Option V → IProp GF :=
  match x✝ with
  | none => iprop(⌜p = null⌝)
  | some v => typedPointsto p v DFrac.discard

theorem smPts_metaRoC (p : Loc) (md : SnapshotMetadataM) : smPts p DFrac.discard md ⊢ ∃ m, metaRoC p
    m ∗ ⌜m.model = md ∧ ∀ (cs : CSC), cs ∈ m.confState → cs.uf = []⌝
